messages:
ashley: escalated from support — AcmeCorp seeing intermittent 504s on hosted inference since ~09:12 PDT. payloads are tiny (<= 200 tokens). customer says errors happen on short sync requests, not obvious traffic surge. filing here for SRE triage. ticket #INC-8219 :boom:

morgan: looking. any error samples or timestamps from gateway?

ashley: pasted the response they get:

HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
date: Tue, 09 Apr 2024 16:12:04 GMT
content-type: application/json
{
  "error": "request_queue_timeout",
  "detail": "request exceeded queue wait deadline"
}

ashley: customer logs show request_id header x-req-id=acme-0a1b

samir: grabbing infra metrics now. preliminary: several hosts show queue_depth at or near max (1024/1024) around 09:10-09:15. continuous-batcher backlog spiked — backlog_count ~72, avg_batch_delay ~420ms. see grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/hosted/queue?from=169... (link truncated) :eyes:

morgan: thanks. can you check auth service latency? sometimes token rotation hung and blocks request acceptance which then piles into gateway queue.

samir: good call — auth-ms p95 climbed to 1.2s at 09:08 due to token refresh loop, and we have a flurry of tenant metadata fetch retries. trace sample shows auth call taking 1.6s then gateway waiting -> backlog.

sre_oncall: stack: ingress LB -> hosted-gateway -> request-queue -> continuous-batcher -> runtime. Evidence points to upstream auth delays causing ingress to accept requests but not progress, queuing up and hitting queue wait deadline. Also saw periodic kvcache spinups on those workers which increased per-request overhead.

morgan: quick repro attempt from within prod region (curl):

curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# returns 504 with body above and header x-req-id=acme-0a1b

sre_oncall: mitigation options:
- short-term: increase request-queue depth for affected gateway pool and bump gateway replicas (kubectl scale) to let backlog drain.
- mid-term: apply routing override to send AcmeCorp traffic to fallback pool/model (lower batching) to avoid queue piling.
- long-term: make auth calls async for request acceptance path or cache tenant tokens TTL longer.

morgan: executed quick scale: kubectl -n hosted scale deployment/gateway-pool-region-us --replicas=6 -> 6 to 8 (scaled to 8). starting to see drain, backlog_count falling from 72 -> 18 in 2m.

samir: also applied temporary route override for tenant acme -> fallback-model-small (no quantization change) via control-plane API:

POST /v1/internal/routing/overrides
Content-Type: application/json
{ "tenant_id": "acme", "route": "fallback-model-small", "expires_in": 3600 }

response 200 OK

ashley: support-bot: posted customer update, saying we identified a queue/backpressure issue, applied temporary mitigation (routing + extra replicas), will follow up with RCA.

support-bot: INC-8219 updated: mitigation applied. Customer notified. ETA for full RCA: 48h.

morgan: followups for oncall/RnD:
- collect full auth-ms traces for 08:55-09:20 window (span sampling).
- capture host-level logs of kvcache churn on gateway workers that experienced spinups.
- consider lowering default queue wait deadline for tiny payloads or accept fast-fail with 429 to avoid tail-504 cascade.

sre_oncall: created follow-up ticket SRE-2032 to track runbook changes (async auth path / cache TTL / queue sizing docs).

ashley: I'll send customer an interim note and ask them to verify if errors stopped (they reported drop in 504s after our mitigation). tagging @morgan to help draft message. :white_check_mark:

morgan: draft note: "We observed a transient backlog in our request queue for your tenant caused by an auth validation latency spike combined with kvcache spinups on a subset of gateway workers. We applied a routing override and scaled capacity which reduced the errors. We're investigating a permanent fix and will follow up with RCA."

ashley: perfect. I'll close the customer-facing loop. leaving this thread for RCA steps.

samir: final note for timeline: 09:06 — auth rotation job started; 09:08 — auth p95 rise; 09:10 — queue depth climb; 09:14 — scale + routing applied; 09:20 — errors subsided.

sre_oncall: marking incident as mitigated, monitoring for 1h. if backlog resurfaces we'll run canary rollback on last deploy (deploy-bot, FYI).

deploy-bot: detected recent gateway config rollout at 08:50 by jules — no immediate correlation but retaining for RCA.

ashley: thanks team. filing RCA draft to SRE-2032 and will update INC-8219 with final notes. :pray:
